name: pending-questions
description: Keeps the questions the agent asks you in a side pane, with when they were asked, until you answer them there or in the chat.

sound.title: Sound on new questions
sound.description: What plays when the agent registers a new pending question, on macOS: alert, the macOS alert sound; ding, a short built-in tone; off, nothing.

tasksFile.title: Tasks file
tasksFile.description: The file the agent keeps its task list in, relative to the project root or absolute. Empty means TASKS.md at the project root. A path picked in the pane for a project wins over this.
